reviews.title: Fake
reviews.text: It’s fake. A scam. Asks you to rate it 5 stars before even getting into the app. Asks you to pay immediately. Either 10 dollars a week or 39 dollars a month or a year for it not to work at all. I did free trial just to see and it won’t show up anything. I even typed in my own stuff for each option (phone, name, email etc) nothing shows up for anything or anyone!! Do not even waste your time. The reviews saying it works are fake also because I tried everything and the. Researched the app, it is literally a scam!! Do not fall for this!! Report it!

reviews.title: Worst Scam Will Take Your Money
reviews.text: This app is completely fake. It most definitely is a scam it won’t find anything for you at all. It will charge you $17 to even try to use the service even if you select free trial. Then before you get any results it will require an additional $10 monthly subscription payment for the next month. This is the craziest scam I have ever seen Apple let through.
